name: Portents of Uldum
label: Quest
description: Portents of Uldum: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, friend, it is fortuitous that you have come to me again. Your revelations at the Uldaman dig site have certainly given us sages much discuss. I was doing just that with one of the druids, Nara Wildmane, when it dawned on me that her past adventuring experiences may have some great importance as to the next step we need to take.
I would like for you to speak with her concerning her travels to the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert. She waits for you on the Elder Rise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There is a place deep in the Tanaris desert called the Valley of the Watchers. The discs that you recovered... Their translated glyphs make mention of a place called Uldum. Most think this place to be a myth.
I know this to be false; Uldum exists. I've been there. Well... Outside, at any rate.
The crux is this, friend: we think there is a connection between the discs and Uldum, and we want you to go there.
